shortDescription: LibertyStream Infrastructure Partners Inc. (TSXV:LIB | OTCQB: VLTLF | FSE: I2D) (“LibertyStream” or the “Company”) announces the postponement of its annual and special meeting of shareholders, originally scheduled for October 15, 2026, to a date to be determined, which is expected to be in the seco…

children: ”) announces the postponement of its annual and special meeting of shareholders, originally scheduled for October 15, 2026, to a date to be determined, which is expected to be in the second half of November 2026.
The revised timing is intended to accommodate business updates of the Company and provide shareholders with an opportunity to consider those updates ahead of the meeting.
The Company will announce the confirmed meeting date, set a new record date and distribute revised meeting materials to shareholders in accordance with applicable securities laws.
Shareholders with questions or who require voting assistance may contact LibertyStream’s proxy solicitation agent:

LibertyStream is a lithium development and technology company aiming to be one of North America’s first commercial producers of lithium carbonate from oilfield brine. Our strategy is to generate value for shareholders by leveraging management’s hydrocarbon experience to deploy our proprietary DLE technology directly into existing oil and gas infrastructure, thereby reducing capital costs, lowering risks and supporting the world’s clean energy transition. We are committed to operating efficiently and with transparency across all areas of the business staying sharply focused on creating long-term, sustainable shareholder value. Investors and/or other interested parties may sign up for updates about the Company’s continued progress on its website: https://LibertyStream.com/.
